title: H^n of a closed disc in an n-dimensional subspace: H^n(P ∩ B̄_r(0)) = ω_n r^n
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, let P be a linear subspace of ℝ^N = Euclidean N with dim P = n (Module.finrank ℝ P = n), and let r ∈ ℝ with r ≥ 0. Then μHE[n](P ∩ closedBall 0 r) = unitBallVolume n · ofReal(r)^n, i.e. H^n(P ∩ B̄_r(0)) = ω_n r^n. Here H^n = μHE[n] is Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N, and ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of ℝ^n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Euclidean N)) (r : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n → 0 ≤ r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((P : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ closedBall 0 r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n
